bootstrap: resample the five trained folds, then slides within each sampled fold
claim_boundaries: Cosine similarity alone does not establish biological preservation.
No slide-independent sign-flip p-values are reported.
Results apply only to the registered paired-acquisition dataset and protocol.
The analysis cannot establish pure biological factors, complete scanner invariance, information-theoretic independence, clinical utility, or universal objective necessity.
seed_averaging: average the five seeds within fold, variant, and slide before any contrast
tissue_or_task_retention_metrics: not available in the registered output schema and therefore not inferred
